mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the unauth-iff-no-caller fact lets Alloy invent an operation with no caller yet outcome=Success, which is exactly the bypass the AuthRequired assertion is supposed to catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuthBypass { some op: Operation | no op.caller and op.outcome = Success and op.kind = GetTaskOp and some op.target }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the read-access guard lets a caller without ownership/share/admin status see a task via GET, which is the byte-equivalent-404 invariant from FR-014.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeakageViolation { some op: Operation | op.kind = GetTaskOp and op.outcome = Success and some op.caller and some op.target and op.caller != op.target.owner and op.caller not in op.target.sharedWith and (op.caller.role != TeamAdminRole or op.caller.team != op.target.taskTeam) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the owner-only share-control fact allows a non-owner (admin or sharee) to successfully PATCH shared_with, violating Q1=A / SC-011.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NonOwnerShareControl { some op: Operation | op.kind = PatchSharedOp and op.outcome = Success and some op.target and some op.caller and op.caller != op.target.owner and op.caller.role = TeamAdminRole and op.caller.team = op.target.taskTeam }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the delete-access fact lets a sharee (a Member in shared_with but not owner and not admin) successfully DELETE a task, which Q3=B forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ShareeCanDelete { some op: Operation | op.kind = DeleteTaskOp and op.outcome = Success and some op.target and some op.caller and op.caller in op.target.sharedWith and op.caller != op.target.owner and op.caller.role = MemberRole }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact lets Alloy place an AuditEntry in the audits of an operation whose outcome is not Success, which directly contradicts FR-018 (audit_unavailable rollback) and FR-017 (audit append-only / no orphan audits).
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OrphanAudit { some op: Operation | op.outcome = AuditUnavailable and some op.audits }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the attribution fact allows an audit entry to record an actor/role different from the operation's actual caller, violating FR-016's snapshot semantics.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_Misattribution { some op: Operation, ae: AuditEntry | ae in op.audits and (ae.actor != op.caller or ae.actorRoleSnap != op.caller.role) }
